in_marathi.name: Manimaran
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manimaran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mani means 'jewel' and Maran means 'death' or 'God of Death'. Manimaran is a deity who is believed to grant wisdom and knowledge to his devotees, thereby helping them overcome the fear of death. This name is derived from the Tamil language and is popular among Hindus.
